rationale: N-000668 refines N-000172 by clarifying that local labels are never adopted as node ids. N-000172 states that local labels resolve to nodes carrying them; N-000668 specifies the constraint that local labels cannot become node ids.
quotes: each cited local label (`S4`, D20) to the nodes of the **same file** carrying it
A local label is **never adopted** as a node id and never fails a build as a duplicate
